title: Enterprises winning with AI agents are limiting autonomy
evidence: Production results indicate enterprises are getting better outcomes when they deliberately constrain what AI agents can decide and do alone.

title: Nvidia AI server prices rise about 17%
evidence: Server makers notified customers of roughly 17% price increases for Nvidia Grace Blackwell 300 and Vera Rubin 200 systems.

title: Cheaper AI models attract enterprise buyers
evidence: Enterprise customers are turning to cheaper AI alternatives despite the availability of more capable premium models.

title: AI-native companies are building sales teams
evidence: Replit, Gamma, Lovable and Anthropic are adding human sales capacity as they pursue enterprise revenue.

title: AI labour effects are appearing in wages
evidence: Apollo Global's chief economist said AI's labour-market impact is appearing in weaker wage growth more than aggregate job losses.

title: Messy documents constrain enterprise AI agents
evidence: Enterprise agent reliability is breaking down where organisational knowledge is siloed and inconsistently structured.

title: Uber fined over opaque automated decisions
evidence: The Dutch Data Protection Authority fined Uber for automated driver-account decisions without adequate disclosure to affected people.
